hook: TitanFlow from Zenith Labs, presented by Dr. Ryan Shelton
claim: TitanFlow, from Zenith Labs, is a urinary-flow supplement for men built around pumpkin seed oil, beta-sitosterol, lycopene, broccoli sprout extract and pygeum. It is presented by Dr. Ryan Shelton, Zenith Labs' medical director.
ing_note: The page explains the role of each ingredient; amounts per capsule aren't given in text.
price_note: A 3-bottle package is also offered at a discount.
refund_note: Zenith Labs offers a 180-day 'empty bottle' guarantee, refunding even if you've used the whole supply.
checks: Pumpkin seed oil, beta-sitosterol and pygeum are among the better-supported herbal options for urinary symptoms of BPH, with modest benefits in trials.
The page claims flow improved 'by over 20%'; trial improvements are real but small compared with prescription drugs.
The claim that 'deep sea divers' eat pumpkin seeds every day is an odd marketing line with no relevance.
Lycopene and broccoli sprouts have no direct evidence for urinary flow.
pros: Includes several of the best-studied herbal BPH ingredients
Low price per bottle on larger packages
Established brand with named medical director
verdict: TitanFlow is one of the more reasonable prostate supplements, because it skips saw palmetto and leans on pumpkin seed oil, beta-sitosterol and pygeum. It may modestly help mild urinary symptoms. Get a PSA test and a doctor's check before relying on it, and see a doctor promptly for blood in the urine, pain or difficulty passing urine.
